description: This file contains test cases for PyTorch's functorch and AOT autograd functionalities, including testing of graph compilation, mutation tracking, autograd correctness, and handling of complex tensor subclasses.

classes.name: AOTTestCase
classes.description: Base test case class for AOT-related tests.

classes.name: TestPythonKey
classes.description: Test cases for Python key functionalities like make_fx, autograd, and nested tensor subclasses.

classes.name: TestAOTAutograd
classes.description: Comprehensive test suite for AOT autograd functionality, including mutation tracking, graph correctness, autograd consistency, and complex tensor subclass handling.

classes.name: TestPartitioning
classes.description: Tests related to partitioning strategies like min-cut and re-compute for graph partitioning and scheduling.

classes.name: TestAOTDispatch
classes.description: Tests for dispatching, subclass handling, in-place mutation, and correctness of AOT functions with various tensor subclasses and mutation scenarios.

classes.name: TestEagerFusionOpInfo
classes.description: Tests for eager fusion operator info, allowing dtypes float and above.

classes.name: TestEagerFusionModuleInfo
classes.description: Tests related to eager fusion module info, including complex mutation scenarios and failures.

classes.name: TestAOTAutogradWithDynamo
classes.description: Subclasses TestAOTAutograd to run tests with Dynamo JIT compilation first, including specialized mutation and graph tests.

classes.name: TestAOTAutogradWithCache
classes.description: In-memory cache version of FXGraphCache testing for FXGraphCache behavior in autograd, with cache miss and hit scenarios, and integration with inductor cache.
